pages.title: The world beyond
pages.text: The Beyond is a separate dimension where the usual laws of life and death take on a new meaning.$(br2)It has forests, rivers and creatures that resemble those of the Overworld. Yet the cutest of them may hide danger, and the strangest may become an ally.

pages.title: How to get there
pages.text: The door to the Beyond is the $(item)Echo of the Beyond$() block. There are two ways:$(br)$(li)hold a $(item)Crystallized Soul$(), switch on $(item)Echo of the Beyond$() and right-click the block (the soul is consumed);$(li)have the “King of the Beyond” advancement: the same, but free.

pages.title: Forest of the Beyond
pages.text: The main biome of the dimension. Mavka Trees and Titan Trees rise among the dense woods.

pages.title: Five regions
pages.text: $(li)$(l:forest/forest)Forest of the Beyond$(/l): mavkas, hukhas and giant trees;$(li)$(l:river/river)The River$(/l): the Vodianyk and vodianytsias;$(li)$(l:night/night_forest)Night Forest$(/l): Povitrulia, Nichnytsia and Perelisnyk;$(li)$(l:mist/misty_forest)Mist Forest$(/l): the Potercha and peaceful dwellers;$(li)$(l:plains/plains)The Plains$(/l): Poludnytsia, the Polovyk, Vovkulaky and the Chort.$(br2)The Night and Mist Forests are varieties of forest, decided by humidity. New regions only appear in parts of the world not yet visited.
